name: YuXin Lustrous Cube 3x3
description: Light up your cubing experience with the YuXin Lustrous Cube 3x3. This cube can cycle through multiple colors (green, blue, pink, red, yellow, and white) which shine through its transparent pieces. Just push down on the yellow and white center cap to start glowing! It also comes with a charging case and cable so the pretty lights can keep shining!
